description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a component for email subscription management in the preRender method.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling email subscription views within the admin plugin. It extends AbstractVueController and initializes the email subscription component in preRender.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by instantiating the 'email-subscription-list' Vue component and assigning it to the controller.
